limitations: Manual acknowledgement records user intent only; the UI never claims it proved an unknown process stopped.
Recovery navigates to a new draft, preserves unknown server state and never cancels, kills or resends the original operation.
Recently observed unknown history is an optional 20-ID local cache, not a complete server-side history or execution authority.
Browser has no native picker; native transport is simulated. This is not real Codex/Claude dialogue or Tauri window acceptance.
macOS-only worker crash evidence; guardian SIGKILL, deliberate daemonization, Windows/Linux and full-goal coverage remain separate.
No commit, push, publication or installed-plugin upgrade. Isolated temporary runtime data will be removed after receipt capture.
